cues.text: Every tailoring ticket needs a measurement. Here is how to read the tape measure.
Always start at zero. Each big number is one inch.
Between two numbers there are little lines. The longest line in the middle is one half.
The next longest lines are one quarter and three quarters.
The short lines are one eighth. Tailors usually work in halves and quarters.
Example: one big number, plus the half line, is one and a half inches. Write it on the ticket as one and a half inches.
Keep the tape flat, not twisted, and always measure twice.
If you are not sure, write down what you see and ask the tailor.
